content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having an issue with [product_name]. I think my program is correct, but I would like to display the analog input from my PT100 sensor on my HMI. I have the PT100 module installed. Can you tell me which variable memory location corresponds to my PT100 sensor? For instance, is it VM 1032 if I have four sensors?
Welcome to the forum. Which HMI are you referring to? Are you talking about the display on [product_name] with HMI capability?
On my KTP400 panel, I can't see the temperature reading from the PT100 sensor (I have the AM2 RTD module installed).

What exactly do you want to display on the HMI? Just the analog input without any scaling? That would show values from 0 to 1000, or do you need the scaled temperature value (e.g., -50.0 to 200.0°C) after processing the analog signal?

Could you provide more details? With enough information, I can make an example for you. Which [product_name] model are you using? What version of [product_name] software do you have? What is the address of your analog input for the PT100 sensor? Which version of [product_name] engineering software do you use?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to display real-time analog input values from a PT100 sensor connected through an AM2 RTD module on an HMI panel (KTP400) using a [product_name] controller. There is uncertainty about which variable memory address to use and how to display either raw or scaled sensor values. The discussion highlights confusion around mapping the hardware input to the HMI and integration steps required.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants clear and accurate visualization of the PT100 sensor’s analog temperature input on the HMI, and is looking for straightforward instructions on mapping the correct variable or memory address to the HMI display. They expect step-by-step guidance for identifying and configuring this setup.
